title: Top-level workspace error banner cannot be dismissed
description: When workspace loading, bot creation, or channel creation fails, the error banner at the top of the chat area has no dismiss button or auto-clear mechanism and remains visible permanently.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CODE CONFIRMED; live banner not present to click-test. `EnabledWorkspace` renders `{error ?
…
: null}` with no dismiss control. Error clears only on `loadWorkspace` start or `selectItem`. `streamError` under the composer is similarly non-dismissible. Fix: add an explicit dismiss (X) that `setError(null)` / `setStreamError(null)`.

comments.author: box
comments.text: Merged to develop via PR #350 (ef5e38d). Dismissible error and streamError alerts.
